name: Little Ant’s Big Adventure
shortDescription: A book-loving little ant leads his colony on a daring expedition to a giant restaurant when their food stores begin to run dry.
longDescription: When an early dry season leaves the colony with almost nothing to eat, Little Ant remembers something he discovered in his books: a nearby restaurant filled with food. Using maps, diagrams and clever inventions, he leads a small expedition across a dangerous road, a rushing gutter and an enormous kitchen. His big adventure proves that reading, curiosity and teamwork can help an entire community.
